Shikakai Powder Wholesale for Hair Care Brands

Shikakai powder is made from the dried pods of Acacia concinna. It is a staple of herbal hair care and is bought by shampoo makers, hair mask brands and private label herbal powder lines. Tradenest Naturals is a shikakai powder exporter and bulk shikakai powder supplier india, based in Surat. As an acacia concinna powder exporter, we keep the colour, texture and particle size steady from lot to lot, so your formulations stay consistent.

Careful Processing and 100 Mesh Fineness

We select shikakai pods carefully and source them from trusted growers. The pods are cleaned, dehydrated and ground into a fine 100 mesh powder. This fine texture mixes easily into shampoos, hair masks and herbal cleansers, with less grit in the finished product. Careful milling also helps keep the natural earthy aroma and the characteristic lather of the pods.

Key Specifications at a Glance

  • Product Name: Shikakai Powder
  • Botanical Name: Acacia concinna
  • Mesh Size: 100 Mesh
  • Processing: Dehydrated
  • Moisture Content: < 8.0%

Applications in Personal Care and Cosmetics

Our pure shikakai powder bulk price options suit brands that want to grow volume over time. Formulators use shikakai in herbal hair washes, dry shampoos and conditioning pastes. It is also a core ingredient in traditional Ayurvedic hair care formulations and in private label herbal hair powder blends.

Buyer Questions Answered

What is the minimum order quantity for shikakai powder wholesale?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg, which suits sampling and first production runs. Contact our sales team for larger volumes.

What documents and quality standards apply?

We are an FSSAI registered food business and follow hygienic processing practices. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer export packaging from small retail pouches to bulk drums. The shelf life is 24 months under recommended storage conditions.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, processing)?

Our standard grade is 100 mesh, with moisture below 8.0%. It is a dehydrated, single-ingredient pod powder.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Send us your quantity and destination, and we will reply with a quotation. Samples are available on request.
